name: 6779-longprompt-qwen05b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1), sm90.
load_profile: concurrent (CLOSED loop), streams=256, bounded at 8192 requests / 1800 s safety, warmup the first 25% by completion.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, prompt exactly 1024 tokens and output exactly 128 tokens (min = max on both), `request_format: plain`; sampling temperature 1.0, top_p 1.0, frequency_penalty 0.1. Declared in full in `configs/scenario.json`.
purpose: A compact half-billion-parameter chat assistant drafting short replies from long 1024-token prompts for 256 concurrent users on one GPU.
launch:
# Use this exact checkpoint: `Qwen/Qwen2-0.5B-Instruct` is a DIFFERENT model despite the
# similar name.
model: Qwen/Qwen1.5-0.5B-Chat

tensor-parallel-size: 1

# Caps how many requests may be RUNNING at once, so it must stay at or above the 256
# concurrent streams scenario.json declares.
max-num-seqs: 256

gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90

dtype: bfloat16

# The workload's worst case is 1024 + 128 = 1152 tokens.
max-model-len: 2048

enable-prefix-caching: false
